关于我 / ABOUT MEABOUT ME / 关于我

我在策略与现场之间，寻找传播真正发生的时刻。 I look for the moment communication becomes real—between strategy and the live experience.

我的学习路径连接了会展经济与管理、新媒体设计和战略传播；实践经历则从内容策划与制作延伸至品牌传播与线下活动推广。这让我既关心一个概念是否清晰，也关心受众最终看见什么、参与什么，以及每个触点能否顺利落地。 My academic path connects Event Economics & Management, New Media Design and Strategic Communication. My practical experience spans content production, automotive brand spaces, major exhibitions and Australian campus activation. This keeps me attentive to both the clarity of an idea and what audiences actually see, do and remember.

PROJECT 01 · 2026

从展位互动到用户转化From booth interaction to user conversion

Dealmoon 布里斯班三校新生节Dealmoon Brisbane Campus Activation

项目背景CONTEXT

参与面向 UQ、QUT 与 Griffith 新生的校园营销活动全流程策划与执行，促进目标用户对产品的认知与首次使用。Participated in the full-cycle planning and execution of campus marketing campaigns targeting new students at UQ, QUT, and Griffith, with the goal of increasing target users’ awareness of the product and encouraging their first-time use.

我的贡献MY CONTRIBUTION

全面参与推广项目从前期筹备、体验设计到落地执行的全过程：协助完成展位规划、现场动线与活动流程设计，梳理推广话术及相关物料；以抽奖权益为沟通切入点，支持产品介绍与新用户引导，制作 Onboarding 手册及活动资料，并搭建 16 个展位的签到抽奖与二维码集章流程，保障各环节顺畅衔接。Contributed across the full lifecycle of the campus activation, from early-stage preparation and experience design to launch and on-site delivery. Supported booth planning, visitor flow design, promotional messaging, and material preparation; used prize incentives as an engagement entry point for product introduction and user onboarding; created onboarding guides and campaign materials; and structured the check-in, prize draw, and QR-code stamp journey across 16 booths to ensure a seamless on-site experience.
